lines.text: Imagine Networks procurement as a city.
Every category we buy is a plot of land.
A hundred and forty-five of them. Seven hundred and sixty million euros of spend, this year.
And a blueprint, the playbook for how we buy it, is what we build on each one.
Welcome to Networks Digital City.
Every lot in it can climb.
It starts as empty ground.
Write the blueprint, and the lot is claimed.
Take it live across markets, and the building rises.
Use it for real sourcing events. Let A.I. write the brief. And the lights come on.
Do all of it, and you reach the top.
Only one category has made the whole climb. Network Professional Services. One hundred, out of a hundred.
So where is Networks today?
Fifty-six categories have a blueprint. Forty-four are active.
Now, switch the city to night mode.
Look up. Eight rooftops are lit. These are the categories already using A.I. to write their briefs.
Now look for the buildings that glow. They only light up where a blueprint has actually been used. Just four buildings. The rest of the city stays dark.
Overall, Networks scores nineteen out of a hundred. Still the first of four stages.
Meet Atlas, the city's A.I. agent. Ask it anything, in plain English.
Ask for a category, and Atlas flies straight there,
and builds the answer, brick by brick.
Now ask what we could build. And watch the city we could be, come to life.
The fastest way up is not writing more. It is using what we have already written.
So write your blueprint.
Use it.
And let A.I. build on it.
Blueprints today. Smart procurement tomorrow.
Find Networks Digital City on the Agent Marketplace.
